name: JellyMold Companion
overview: Watch history for JellyMold and any other app.
description: A permanent record of everything each person watches and listens to on this server, readable by each person from an app. Survives media being deleted from the library; never deletes history.

versions.changelog: Phase 2: past history. Each person's baseline from Jellyfin's watch state, taken automatically; Playback Reporting's database; Trakt, Letterboxd and CSV files. Every import previews first and can be undone. Includes everything from Phase 1.
